parameters.name: group
parameters.description: The group to which the service belongs.

parameters.name: ip
parameters.description: The IP address of the service provider. Fuzzy searches are supported.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description:
The source of the data. Valid values:

*   agent: Use this value if you use the service query feature of the latest version to pass the query result.
*   registry: Use this value if you use the service query feature of the earlier version to pass the query result.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region ID of the service.

parameters.name: registryType
parameters.description: The type of the service registry. This parameter is deprecated. You can ignore it.

parameters.name: serviceId
parameters.description: The ID of the service. This parameter is deprecated. You can ignore it.

parameters.name: serviceType
parameters.description:
The type of the service. Valid values:

*   dubbo
*   springCloud
*   hsf
*   istio

parameters.name: source
parameters.description: The source of the service. Set the value to edas.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun edas get-service-detail --biz-region cn-hangzhou --namespace cn-hangzhou:doc-test --origin agent --service-type springCloud --app-id efbda488-7b33-432f-a40d-000000470000 --source edas --service-id com.alibabacloud.hipstershop.CartService --service-name com.alibabacloud.hipstershop.CartService --service-version 1.0.0 --group DUBBO --ip 10.20.x.xx --registry-type nacos --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun edas POST /pop/sp/api/mseForOam/getServiceDetail --region cn-hangzhou --serviceType springCloud --serviceVersion '1.0.0' --registryType nacos --origin agent --appId 'efbda488-7b33-432f-a40d-000000470000' --ip '10.20.x.xx' --namespace 'cn-hangzhou:doc-test' --source edas --region 'cn-hangzhou' --serviceId 'com.alibabacloud.hipstershop.CartService' --serviceName 'com.alibabacloud.hipstershop.CartService' --group DUBBO --header "Content-Type=application/json"
